senses.gloss: c. (πίναξ) board, tablet, esp. (πίνακες) the folded writing tablets; register, list.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:4">Sabb. XII, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00233"><he>לוּחַ</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>על שני דפי פ׳</he> on two boards of a pinax (Rashi: two columns on one tablet).
<cite ref="Niddah 30b">Nidd. 30ᵇ</cite> the embryo in the womb <he>דומה לפ׳ שמקופל</he> resembles in position a folded pinax.
Gen. R. s. 69 (ref. to Gen. XXVIII, 13) קפלה כפ׳ ונתנה וכ׳ he (the Lord) folded it (the land) like a pinax and placed it under his (Jacob’s) head; a. fr.—Esp. the merchant’s accounts, book.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:16">Ab. III, 16</cite> <he>הפ׳ פתוח והיד וכ׳</he> the book of (God’s) accounts lies open, and the hand writes, and whosoever wishes to borrow may come and borrow &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 7:1">Shebu. VII, 1</cite> <he>החנוני על פִּינַקְסוֹ</he> Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. <he>פנ׳</he>), v. <cite ref="H01257"><he>חֶנְוָונִי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 7:1">Ib.</cite> <he>כתוב בפִינַקְסִי וכ׳</he> Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. <he>על פנ׳</he>) it is written in my book that thou owest me &c. Y. Ned. I, 36ᵈ <he>פינקסו נפתחת</he> his account book is open (his sins will be visited); <cite ref="Yoma 2a:3">ib.</cite> <cite ref="Q00739"><he>פינקסתו</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 81">Gen. R. s. 81</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01136"><he>בָּקַר</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פִּינַקְסִין</he>, <he>פִּינַקְסָאוֹת</he>, <he>פִּינַקְסָיוֹת</he>, <cite ref="Q00738"><he>פִּנַ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> <he>דיפתראות ופ׳ יש לו</he> he (the builder) has before him rolls and tablets (plans and descriptions).
